BeginNotificationDeliveryContextRead.reason: The shared due-row query filters channel, status and due time before the 1000-row limit. The bounded rendering projection only pins installed recipient, review and HIPAA metadata after a matching row is found. Native notification and issue display fields share a SQL snapshot for byte preflight and transfer. The owner stays live through SMTP and delivery result writes. Off mode forwards the selection to NotificationDeliverySnapshot. TestScaleHotDeliveryEmailDifferential compares immediate and digest messages and delivery state with the flag off and on. TestScaleHotDeliveryContextSourceAndCountBound covers installed-source drift, cancellation, bounded work and cleanup.
BeginNotificationDeliveryContextRead.temperatureReason: Immediate and digest email rendering on ordinary notification writes and delivery ticks.

DueIntegrationDeliveryIDs.reason: The bounded visitor reads only ID, status, attempts and next-attempt headers in installed order and keeps the source charged through each callback. Off mode collects only due IDs under the workspace read lock and invokes the callbacks after releasing it. Both paths use the same due predicate. TestScaleHotDeliveryContextSourceAndCountBound covers ordering, eligibility, large payloads and cleanup.
